Muted slate blue, graphite, pale sage teal, warm ivory, and warm amber/copper accents; soft directional studio side lighting. Main objects centrally grouped within the middle 55% of the frame. No people, words, letters, numbers, currency symbols, lightning bolts, logos, charts, graphs, arrows, or watermarks. Clearly a conceptual editorial still life, not documentary photography.
